newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Wesfarmers first qtr profit rises.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Wesfarmers first qtr profit rises.

text.p: Diversified industrial group Wesfarmers Ltd said on Wednesday net profit in the three months to September 30 was $21.3 million, a rise of 65 percent on the A$12.9 million year-ago profit.
The company also said first quarter sales rose 8.0 percent to A$603 million.

"Owing to seasonality, the first quarter contributes a relatively smaller share of profits for Wesfarmers than the remaining three quarters and the percentage rate of profit growth achieved in this quarter will not be maintained over the full year," the company said.

"The result will, however, assist the company to achieve the reasonable profit increase budgeted for the full year. Directors consider that this will be an acceptable performance given the continued depressed conditions in housing, wool and cattle," it said.
Wesfarmers said the first quarter profit result included a one-off net gain of A$2.6 million from the sale of the company's investment in Dyno Wesfarmers Ltd.
It said the increased three month result was due to higher contributions from chemical and fertiliser group Wesfarmers CSBP and pastoral house Wesfarmers Dalgety.
Earnings from Wesfarmers Energy fell slightly while the volume of gas sales was marginally higher.
Wesfarmers Bunnings' forest product operations reflected the depressed housing market in Western Australia and lower woodchip sales. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
